q: When an object is placed in a liquid of a lower density, the object _____.
e: When an object is placed in a liquid of a lower density, the object sinks. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies involving liquid.

q: If an object is placed in a liquid of a greater density, it _____.
e: If an object is placed in a liquid of a greater density, it floats. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

q: The amount of submerged portion for a floating body is _____ proportional to the specific gravity of the liquid.
e: The amount of submerged portion for a floating body is inversely proportional to the specific gravity of the liquid. The physics in this sentence is built around inversely.

q: The more submerged a floating body is, the _____ the specific gravity.
e: The more submerged a floating body is, the less the specific gravity. The physics in this sentence is built around less.

q: The hydrometer is an instrument for measuring the density (or) _____ of liquids.
e: The hydrometer is an instrument for measuring the density (or) relative density of liquids. Relative density here means mass per unit volume. Absolute temperature: how hot or cold a body is.

q: A hydrometer usually consists of a glass tube with a long _____ at one end.
e: A hydrometer usually consists of a glass tube with a long bulb at one end. The physics in this sentence is built around bulb.

q: The bulb of a hydrometer is weighted with _____ so that the device floats vertically.
e: The bulb of a hydrometer is weighted with lead shot so that the device floats vertically. The physics in this sentence is built around lead shot.

q: The relative density of a liquid is read off the calibrated stem of a hydrometer by the _____.
e: The relative density of a liquid is read off the calibrated stem of a hydrometer by the depth of immersion. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

q: If the hydrometer floats higher, it indicates that the liquid has a _____ density.
e: If the hydrometer floats higher, it indicates that the liquid has a higher density. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies involving indicates.

q: The hydrometer sinks in the liquid until the weight of the liquid displaced is equal to the _____ of the hydrometer.
e: The hydrometer sinks in the liquid until the weight of the liquid displaced is equal to the weight of the hydrometer. Weight here means the gravitational pull of the Earth on a body, a downward force.

q: The hydrometer is calibrated to measure the density of the liquid in _____.
e: The hydrometer is calibrated to measure the density of the liquid in $\text{kg m}^{-3}$. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies involving density.

q: Special hydrometers are used to test the specific gravity of solutions in _____ in order to determine the condition of the battery.
e: Special hydrometers are used to test the specific gravity of solutions in storage batteries in order to determine the condition of the battery. The physics in this sentence is built around storage batteries involving test.

q: The relative density of the acid in a fully charged car battery is _____.
e: The relative density of the acid in a fully charged car battery is 1.25. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies involving fully.

q: Milk and wine can be tested with a hydrometer to make sure they have not been diluted with _____.
e: Milk and wine can be tested with a hydrometer to make sure they have not been diluted with water. The physics in this sentence is built around water.

q: A test tube used as a hydrometer must have an overall density less than one or less than the density of _____.
e: A test tube used as a hydrometer must have an overall density less than one or less than the density of water. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

q: Force exerted on a sail in a low pressure area is due to the atmospheric pressure _____.
e: Force exerted on a sail in a low pressure area is due to the atmospheric pressure difference. The same force on a smaller area means a larger pressure.

q: In the Archimedes crown problem, the added metal was suspected to be copper because it has a similar _____ to gold.
e: In the Archimedes crown problem, the added metal was suspected to be copper because it has a similar color to gold. The physics in this sentence is built around color. Density: mass per unit volume.

q: The density of pure gold is _____ $\text{g cm}^{-3}$.
e: The density of pure gold is 19.3 $\text{g cm}^{-3}$. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

q: In the crown problem, Archimedes found the actual volume of the crown to be _____ $\text{cm}^3$.
e: In the crown problem, Archimedes found the actual volume of the crown to be 315 $\text{cm}^3$. The physics in this sentence is built around 315.

q: The mass of the King's crown in the Archimedes problem was _____ g.
e: The mass of the King's crown in the Archimedes problem was 3750 g. The physics in this sentence is built around 3750.

q: For a floating hydrometer, the weight of the hydrometer equals the volume of liquid displaced multiplied by the density of the liquid and _____.
e: For a floating hydrometer, the weight of the hydrometer equals the volume of liquid displaced multiplied by the density of the liquid and $g$. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.
